import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/field_visit_log.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Visit Log', header=4)

# Clean column names
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]

# Drop rows where Visit ID is NaN
df = df.dropna(subset=['Visit ID'])

# Normalize village names: trim outer whitespace, collapse internal whitespace, case-insensitive for comparison
def normalize_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return ''
    s = str(v).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

df['Village_normalized'] = df['Village'].apply(normalize_village)

# Deduplicate Visit ID by keeping first spreadsheet occurrence
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')

# For debugging: check Programme unique values
print("Unique Programmes:", df_dedup['Programme'].dropna().unique())

# Filter for Health & Nutrition visits in Odisha
# Normalize state for comparison case-insensitive
def normalize_state(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

df_dedup['State_normalized'] = df_dedup['State'].apply(normalize_state)

mask = (
    df_dedup['Programme'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower() == 'health & nutrition'
) & (
    df_dedup['State_normalized'] == 'odisha'
)

filtered = df_dedup[mask]

# Ensure Women Reached is numeric
filtered['Women Reached'] = pd.to_numeric(filtered['Women Reached'], errors='coerce')

total_women = filtered['Women Reached'].sum(skipna=True)
print("Filtered rows:", len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Visit ID','State','Programme','Women Reached']].head(20))
print("Total women:", total_women)
